patch_description: This version retains the reproducible barycentric simulated-annealing search from the current implementation, while adding a deterministic nonlinear constrained polishing phase when SciPy is available. The annealing phase explores multiple global layouts inside the simplex, and the SLSQP phase then directly maximizes an auxiliary minimum-area variable subject to all signed triangle-area constraints and simplex containment constraints. If SciPy is unavailable or polishing fails, the best valid annealed arrangement is returned gracefully.
